title: Provider: wolfssl_aes_cbc — true streaming update()
description:
Fix src/providers/wolfssl/wolfssl_aes_cbc.c to process complete blocks in update() instead of accumulating all input in ctx->inbuf.

Current (batch) behavior:
- update() appends to ctx->inbuf
- finalize() calls wc_AesCbcEncrypt(ctx->inbuf, full_len)

Required (streaming) behavior:
- update() partitions input into: complete 16-byte blocks + trailing partial block
- update() calls wc_AesCbcEncrypt() on all complete blocks immediately, writes ciphertext to out[]
- update() saves trailing partial bytes (0-15) in ctx->tail[] for finalize
- finalize() applies PKCS#7 padding to ctx->tail[], encrypts final block, writes to out[]
- ctx->inbuf is removed; ctx->tail[16] (max one AES block) replaces it

For decrypt:
- update() similarly: hold back one full block to detect padding on finalize
- finalize() strips PKCS#7 padding

Key correctness check: the CBC chaining state (last ciphertext block) is maintained in the wc_Aes struct across update() calls — do NOT reset it between calls.

Test vectors: existing NIST CAVP vectors in tests/vectors/aes_cbc.h must still pass.
